killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) stores each typeface's SIL Open Font License whole, under that face's own copyright line
why: Points IBM Plex Mono at IBM Plex Sans's license file, the arrangement the fonts shipped with before the #294 cutover audit: the same OFL text under the wrong copyright line (Sans says 2019, Mono's own package says 2017). Every rendered section still carries a whole OFL, so only a check that spells each face's copyright line literally can tell. Scoped to vendored.test.ts alone: generate.test.ts's regenerate-and-diff would also fail, but only until `npm run notices` is run, after which the declaration and the committed notices agree on the mistake.
